subject_uz: Tibbiy radioaktiv yuklarni (UN2915) xalqaro yo'nalishlarda havo transportida tashish xizmati

requirements.summary_uz: Tibbiy maqsadlardagi radioaktiv materiallar (7-sinf, UN2915) xalqaro yo'nalishlarda tashiladi.
requirements.summary_en: Medical radioactive materials (class 7, UN2915) are shipped on international routes.

requirements.summary_uz: Tashish haftalik ravishda belgilangan yo'nalishlar bo'yicha amalga oshiriladi.
requirements.summary_en: Shipments run weekly on the listed routes.
requirements.quote: haftalik ravishda quyidagi yo'nalishlar bo'yicha amalga oshiriladi

requirements.summary_uz: Oylik o'rtacha yuk og'irligi 500 kg dan 700 kg gacha yoki undan ko'p.
requirements.summary_en: Average monthly cargo weight is 500 to 700 kg or more.
requirements.quote: Oylik o'rtacha umumiy yuk og'irligi 500 kg dan 700 kg gacha yoki undan ko'p.

requirements.summary_uz: Pudratchi qadoqlash hujjatlari, belgilar va xavfli yuk markirovkasini IATA, ICAO va IAEA qoidalariga muvofiq tekshiradi.
requirements.summary_en: The contractor checks packaging documents, marks and hazard labels against IATA, ICAO and IAEA rules.
requirements.quote: Pudratchi IATA, ICAO va IAEA qoidalariga muvofiq ravishda qadoqlashga qo'yilgan

requirements.summary_uz: Radioaktiv materiallarni havo orqali tashish uchun litsenziya yoki ruxsatnoma bo'lishi kerak.
requirements.summary_en: A licence or permit for air transport of radioactive materials is required.
requirements.quote: Radioaktiv materiallarni havo transportida tashish uchun tegishli litsenziya yoki

requirements.summary_uz: Shtatda amaldagi IATA DGR sertifikatli 3 yoki undan ko'p xavfli yuk mutaxassisi bo'lsa 5 ball.
requirements.summary_en: 5 points for 3 or more in-house specialists with valid IATA DGR certificates.
requirements.quote: Shtatda amaldagi IATA DGR sertifikatlariga ega 3 yoki undan ortiq xavfli yuklar bo'yicha mutaxassisning mavjudligi

requirements.summary_uz: Aviakompaniyaning ijobiy tavsiyasi yoki sharhi bo'lsa 5 ball (bu mezon matni ikki marta kiritilgan).
requirements.summary_en: 5 points for a positive airline recommendation or review (the same criterion text is entered twice).
requirements.quote: Aviakompaniyaning ijobiy tavsiyasi yoki sharhi mavjudligi; bo'lsa 5- ball

requirements.summary_uz: Baholash mezonlari: texnik qism 70%, narx 30%, o'tish bali 20 (mezonlarning jami maksimal bali ham 20).
requirements.summary_en: Scoring: technical 70%, price 30%, pass mark 20 (the criteria also add up to a maximum of 20).

requirements.summary_uz: Soliq xizmati va bank oldida qarzi yo'qligi to'g'risida ma'lumotnoma taqdim etiladi.
requirements.summary_en: A certificate of no debt to the tax service and the servicing bank is provided.
requirements.quote: soliq xizmati va xizmat ko'rsatuvchi bank oldida qarzi yo'qligi to'g'risida

requirements.summary_uz: Ishtirokchi insofsiz ijrochilarning yagona reyestrida bo'lmasligi kerak.
requirements.summary_en: The bidder must not be on the single register of unfair suppliers.
requirements.quote: Инсофсиз ижрочиларнинг ягона реестрида қайд этилмаганлиги.

flags.explanation_uz: Mezonlarning jami maksimal bali 20, o'tish bali ham 20. Bunda ishtirokchi har bir mezonda to'liq ball olishi kerak bo'ladi, jumladan aviakompaniya tavsiyasi va shtatda 3 ta sertifikatli mutaxassis uchun. Kichikroq yoki yangi yuk agentlari yaxshi taklif bilan ham o'ta olmasligi mumkin; bu qiymatni tekshirib ko'rish tavsiya etiladi.
flags.explanation_en: The criteria add up to a maximum of 20 points and the pass mark is also 20, so a bidder would need full marks on every criterion, including an airline recommendation and three certified in-house specialists. A smaller or newer cargo agent could fail even with a sound offer; the value is worth checking.
flags.rewrite_uz: Baholash mezonlari: texnik qism 70%, narx 30%, o'tish bali texnik qism maksimal ballining 60 foizi.
flags.rewrite_en: Evaluation criteria: technical part 70%, price 30%, pass mark 60 percent of the maximum technical score.

flags.quote: Aviakompaniyaning ijobiy tavsiyasi yoki sharhi mavjudligi; bo'lsa 5- ball
flags.explanation_uz: Xuddi shu aviakompaniya tavsiyasi mezoni ikki marta (1- va 3-mezon) kiritilgan va jami 20 balldan 10 balli shunga bog'liq. Kichik yoki yangi yuk agentlari bunday tavsiyani olishi qiyin bo'lishi mumkin. Bu bo'yicha aniqlashtiruvchi savol berish mumkin.
flags.explanation_en: The same airline-recommendation criterion appears twice (criteria 1 and 3), so 10 of the 20 points depend on it. A small or new cargo agent may find such a letter hard to obtain. A clarifying question is worthwhile.
flags.rewrite_uz: Aviakompaniya tavsiyasi bitta mezon sifatida kiritilsin yoki unga teng boshqa tasdiq (masalan, oldingi xizmat shartnomalari) ham qabul qilinsin.
flags.rewrite_en: Count the airline recommendation as a single criterion, or also accept equivalent proof such as earlier service contracts.

Soliq xizmati va bank oldida qarzdorlik yo'qligi to'g'risida ma'lumotnoma
